vectors.name: Opaque media metadata only
vectors.expect: published and versioned media events contain a digest and opaque reference, never raw video, music, messages, credentials, or keys

vectors.name: Product-owned consent
vectors.expect: shared and access-granted events require an authorized permission summary; Data Fabric cannot create access authority

vectors.name: Fail-closed revocation
vectors.expect: access revocation and asset deletion remain explicit, auditable, versioned events and cannot be silently overwritten

vectors.name: Cross-product pseudonymization
vectors.expect: ownerReference is per-product pseudonymous and no public account, recipient list, or cross-product identifier is allowed

vectors.name: Chain commitment is external
vectors.expect: chainCommitmentId is an optional read-only external integrity reference and does not copy raw content or control product permissions
